subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Hobby is a work which a man undertakes __when he is not working__ for pleasure.
solution:
The correct answer is "**In his spare time**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined segment in the given sentence means an **activity that a person engages in when they are not occupied with work**.
 
• "**in his spare time**" means the **same thing** as the original sentence.
 
• **Spare time** is the **free time that someone has to do what they want**.
 
• Therefore, this option is the most appropriate substitute for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Thus, ***option 4*** is the correct answer.
